question: total building area km2
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000000 AS total_area_km2 FROM lisbon_buildings;

question: total road length km
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000 AS total_length_km FROM lisbon_roads;

question: footway length km
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000 AS footway_length_km FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway';

question: apartment building area m2
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry)) AS area_m2 FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE class = 'apartments';

question: avg building area by roof shape
sql: SELECT roof_shape, AVG(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry)) AS avg_area_m2 FROM lisbon_buildings GROUP BY roof_shape ORDER BY avg_area_m2 DESC;

question: road length by class
sql: SELECT class, SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000 AS length_km FROM lisbon_roads GROUP BY class ORDER BY length_km DESC;
